rationale: diffusion_recon_dcstep_unconstrained_mayo_v4-claude-agentic: recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/ddpm_mayo_unconstrained_v4.pt, recon_mode=dps, recon_sample_steps=200, recon_eta=80.0, recon_init=fbp, recon_eta_clamp=True, recon_dcstep_every=12, recon_dcstep_n_cg=20, recon_dcstep_warmup=5, recon_dcstep_relax=1.0, val_n=20, train_n=0, seed=42, rationale=iter-12 (toward 20): recon_dcstep_warmup 25->5 at the saturated eta=80 / dcstep_every=12 / n_cg=20 optimum. ALL soft-DC STRENGTH levers are exhausted at ~0.867: dcstep_every peaked at 12 (8=0.828,20=0.835), eta SATURATED (40=0.8657->80=0.8661), sample_steps=200 (100 under-samples), n_cg 10->20 gained only +0.0008. recon_dcstep_warmup has been HELD at 25 the entire run -- the one untouched, structurally-distinct lever. With recon_init=fbp the sample is already near-clean from step 0, so skipping the first 25 (~12.5% of 200) reverse steps WASTES early DC projections that could pull the FBP-init sample toward the data manifold. UNCONSTRAINED DPS is structurally hr=0 (<LD-FBP ~0.94): soft adaptive-weight gradient never enforces Ax=y. Hyp: lowering warmup 25->5 engages data-consistency ~10pct earlier; if SSIM rises past ~0.867 the warmup was suppressing usable early DC, if flat it DOCUMENTS the soft-DC ceiling is warmup-insensitive and firm below hard-DC. Wall: iter-11 was 1028s with n_cg=20; +20 early DC-steps at n_cg=20 adds modest CG cost, stays well under the 1h wall.
